learn_findings.finding: Course modules misclassified uniformly as L4 (recommendation b in BRI-491 Q2 suggests Modules 01-07 should be L2). Logged as KBG-07 for re-classification pass.

EMS stocking email (Justin at ABC Supply, 2026-08-06) contained distributor-tier Tier 1/Tier 2 pricing. Correctly SKIPPED from L4 ingest. Pattern: classify by smallest tier BEFORE ingesting, not after. Will apply same filter to Great Meeting Today recap (2026-07-13) and Josh diligence package (2026-09-29) which are also distributor/investor tier.

Mike MOL onboarding email (2026-07-08) is REP-tier (L5), not L4 contractor. Entire email structure addresses the rep role (compensation, 5-phase roadmap, playbooks for working with contractors). Even where sub-content is tier-safe, extracting from a rep-tier email risks tier mixing. Pattern: pull voice from contractor-facing emails directly, not from derived rep-track emails.

Dana/Screen Factory Florida email (2026-09-25) states 'registration within 90 days' which conflicts with BRI-484 60-day FINAL ruling. Caught during ingest, filed as doctrine_note on L4-VOICE-WARRANTY-FIELD-NARRATIVE AND as KBG-09 for website/template update.
